Entry on universe addition (equities only): from the underlying's option chain keep contracts expiring at least 30 days out (abandon if fewer than two), take the earliest such expiry, the strike closest to the underlying price, and require both a call and a put at that strike; add both contracts and buy one straddle via a combo market order. Exit on universe removal: liquidate the underlying and remove both option contracts.

Class attribute _risk_per_trade = 0.01. initialize: set_start_date(2024, 9, 1), set_end_date(2024, 12, 31), set_cash(250000), settings.seed_initial_prices = True, settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True; for ticker in ['SPY', 'QQQ', 'IWM', 'EFA', 'EEM']: equity = add_equity(ticker); equity.entry = self.dch(equity, 20, 20, Resolution.DAILY); equity.exit = self.dch(equity, 10, 10, Resolution.DAILY); equity.atr = self.atr(equity, 20, MovingAverageType.SIMPLE, Resolution.DAILY); schedule.on(date_rules.every_day('SPY'), time_rules.after_market_open('SPY', 1), self._rebalance). _rebalance: for security in securities.values(): continue if not security.atr.is_ready; price = security.price; quantity = security.holdings.quantity; if quantity == 0 and price > security.entry.upper_band.current.value: risk_shares = portfolio.total_portfolio_value * _risk_per_trade / security.atr.current.value; cap_shares = calculate_order_quantity(security, 1 / len(securities)); shares = int(min(risk_shares, cap_shares)); if shares: market_order(security, shares); elif quantity > 0 and price < security.exit.lower_band.current.value: liquidate(security).

equity-keltner-squeeze | reference | ceiling | QuantConnect Python, snake_case. initialize: set_start_date(2024, 9, 1), set_end_date(2024, 12, 31), set_cash(100_000), settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True; tickers = ['SPY', 'QQQ', 'IWM', 'DIA']; _weight = 1.0 / len(tickers); for ticker: equity = add_equity(ticker); equity.bb = self.bb(equity, 20, 1.5, resolution=Resolution.DAILY); equity.kc = self.kch(equity, 20, 2.0, resolution=Resolution.DAILY); equity.in_squeeze = False; equity.armed = False; schedule.on(date_rules.every_day('SPY'), time_rules.after_market_open('SPY', 1), self._rebalance). _rebalance: for security in securities.values(): continue unless bb and kc ready; read bb upper/lower/middle, kc upper/lower, price; in_squeeze = bb_upper < kc_upper and bb_lower > kc_lower; if in_squeeze and not security.in_squeeze: security.armed = True; security.in_squeeze = in_squeeze; holding = security.holdings; if holding.invested: if (holding.quantity > 0 and price <= bb_middle) or (holding.quantity < 0 and price >= bb_middle): liquidate(security); continue; continue if in_squeeze or not security.armed; if price > bb_upper: set_holdings(security, _weight); armed = False; elif price < bb_lower: set_holdings(security, -_weight); armed = False.
